events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis: Iran-US-Israel Stalemate Continues
events.summary: US-Israel war on Iran (since Feb 2026) continues. Strait of Hormuz effectively closed by Tehran. 20M barrels/day oil flow disrupted. Houthi attacks on Bab al-Mandeb strait killing crew members. Brent crude at ~$89.53, up 24% since war began. Iran threatens offensive action if diplomacy fails. Negotiations stalled.

events.title: Historic US-Japan Yen Intervention FAILING - Yen Sliding Back to 160
events.summary: Joint US-Japan currency intervention (July 31, $34B deployed) has erased half its gains within 2 weeks. Yen back near 160 level. US Treasury sold euros (not dollars) to fund intervention, signaling stress in Treasury market. FIMA repo facility upsized. BOJ under pressure to normalize rates by September. Structural forces overwhelming intervention.

events.title: Global Synchronized Bond Sell-Off: Credit Bubble Terminal Phase
events.summary: Global bond markets in synchronized sell-off. German Bund yields at 3.255% (highest since 2011). JGB 10Y at 2.95% (3-decade high). UK gilts disproportionately exposed - BOE facing impossible choice between rate cuts for weak growth and hikes for oil-driven inflation. Credit bubble analyst Doug Noland warns of terminal phase. ECB set for final rate hike next month.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic: Fastest-Growing Outbreak on Record, WHO PHEIC Declared
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC now deadliest in country history. 4,945 confirmed cases, 2,325 deaths (as of Aug 15). 730 patients hospitalized. Spread to Uganda. WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Existing Ebola treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo - complicating response.

events.title: Gold at $4,339 - Safe Haven Demand Surge on Middle East Crisis
events.summary: Gold hit fresh 2-month peak near $4,450 in early August. Currently $4,339/oz, up 8.27% past month, up 29.72% YoY. Central bank buying (especially China) + geopolitical tensions driving safe-haven demand. Futures briefly touched $4,500.

events.title: UK Gilts Disproportionately Exposed to Global Bond Sell-Off
events.summary: UK gilts hit harder than peers in global bond sell-off. BOE facing impossible policy dilemma: weak growth demands cuts, oil-driven inflation demands hikes. Markets swung from pricing cuts to pricing hikes within months. CPI at 2.6% (above 2% target).

events.title: China July Bank Loans Post Record Contraction - Deflation Fight Faltering
events.summary: China bank loans contracted in July 2026 - second time on record. Credit demand faltering despite PBOC easing. Deflation fight losing ground in real time. Property crisis ongoing. PBOC maintaining stable currency to avoid devaluation triggers with Washington.

events.title: Nigeria-South Africa Diplomatic Crisis: Afrophobic Violence, Evacuations
events.summary: Nigeria evacuating citizens from South Africa amid rising afrophobic tensions. 83 more citizens scheduled for evacuation Aug 19. Diplomatic confrontation at Commonwealth Parliamentary Association conference.

summary: 8 cat-5 events detected across 12 domains. 2 severity-5 (Hormuz war, Ebola PHEIC), 2 severity-4 (yen intervention failure, bond sell-off), 3 severity-3 (gold surge, UK gilts, China credit), 1 severity-2 (Nigeria-SA). Signal board updated: macro_event added, 8 signals escalated.
